description: We are NEU Marswalk, a team building Marswalk: an EVA planner and helmet HUD that lets Mars astronauts plan and rehearse safe walks on real NASA terrain (HiRISE, THEMIS, CRISM). We love space, maps, 3D graphics and data. Our skills: web development (JavaScript, Three.js), Python data processing, and GIS. We’d welcome teammates with skills in UI/UX design, video editing, planetary science, or public speaking. Join us to explore Mars one step at a time!
